story.story:
Dawn light falls across a wooden table in the Morning Kitchen. A ceramic Plaid Mug stands on the wooden table, its handle turned toward the edge. Steam rises from the hot brewed coffee, curling above the Plaid Mug.

The camera moves closer. The plaid pattern fills more of the frame. Beyond the wooden table, the Morning Kitchen remains softly out of focus. A faint birdcall sounds outside.

Alex’s hand enters beside the Plaid Mug. Alex’s fingers settle around the handle. The camera holds. The Plaid Mug stays on the wooden table for another beat.

Then Alex slowly lifts the Plaid Mug. A soft scrape gives way to quiet. Steam trails through the dawn light as the Plaid Mug rises out of frame.

The camera holds on the wooden table. The Cabin Coffee Company logo appears: an irregular burgundy five-point star beside bold, condensed black lettering stacked as CABIN / COFFEE CO.

Beneath the logo, the words appear: Wake up slow.
